reply_text:
I've answered Ilse in a thread reply on her #north-team message. The contact is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines, and she's their main contact.

- **Where this comes from:** On 20 Aug 2025 in #north-team, Dana Okafor said Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up as two 06:30 check-ins: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added him by hand. Ilse was in that conversation too.
- **"Main contact" title:** That comes from the North team cheat sheet, a public file.
- **Account owner:** My reply also says Dana owns the account day to day. That rests on brain notes calling it "Dana's freight account"; I didn't find a CRM record saying so.

I couldn't see any files in the Quarrendon account folders, so I didn't check a CRM contact record. I also didn't confirm Thea is still the contact today: the door 6 report and the cheat sheet are from 2025. The latest note I found is from March 2026, when she co-signed the renewal. I left the seat counts from that same conversation out of the reply because Ilse didn't ask for them.
